findings: 32GiB RLIMIT_AS is a hard virtual-space cap, not a physical-RAM cap.
6GiB VmRSS and cgroup limit minus1GiB resident-floor reserve are checked every0.5s; TERM gets up to5s before KILL.
Admission requires physical_budget + baseline resident_floor + reserve <= finite cgroup limit; at8GiB/6GiB/1GiB this requires baseline floor<=1GiB.
resident_floor sums anon,kernel,shmem,file_dirty,file_writeback; clean file cache is omitted.
Stop checks current VmRSS; VmHWM is recorded as a peak, not used as the stop threshold.
Sampling and termination grace permit overshoot; the enclosing cgroup is the sole hard physical limit.
OOM event deltas invalidate the final result; timeout excludes pre/post frozen-input validation.
Exact full-root fresh banner, exit0, and unchanged post-input guards remain mandatory; no fallback.
recommendation: No configuration change or checker launch based solely on old interrupted run.
